messages:
Marco (AE): Passing Copperstrand to CS — signed yesterday, PO in. Go-live target 2024-10-15, renewal window around 2025-01-30 (FYI, looks like a Q1 renewal upsell opportunity). :tada:
Priya (CS): thanks Marco. quick summary of blockers?
Marco (AE): main blockers: SAML metadata still with their security team, network needs to approve VPC peering (they want private deploy later), and they asked for a 250ms p95 latency goal. Initial usage estimate ~5 rps per active user, ~500 DAU. Legal + billing done.
Marco (AE): also note they plan to send product telemetry (embeddings + usage logs) to our ingestion bucket — need SOC review around data retention. :warning:
Priya (CS): got it. I'll own onboarding + success plan. Can someone from Support be the SSO test owner? @Sasha?
Sasha (Support): I can own SSO testing window. please send SAML metadata and test SP endpoints. propose we block 2 hours w/ their IdP team next week. :+1:
Priya (CS): action items I have so far:
• Kickoff call w/ customer (owners: Priya + Marco) — schedule this week.
• SSO validation (owner: Sasha) — need SAML metadata and test account.
• VPC peering intake (owner: Dmitri) — network info + desired CIDR.
• Latency SLO baseline (owner: Dmitri + Priya) — run perf smoke and share p95 numbers.
• Data retention & SOC checklist (owner: Priya) — share policy doc with customer.
Dmitri (Eng): I can take VPC peering intake and the perf baseline. If they want cost savings we can recommend a 4-bit quantized variant for embeddings, but need to validate quality. I can slot a 90-min tech deep dive next Tue.
onboard-bot: CHECKLIST CREATED: 1) kickoff scheduled 2) SAML metadata received 3) peering template submitted 4) perf smoke results uploaded. Assign owners and update when done.
Priya (CS): Next steps from me: 1) book kickoff (Marco — can you intro w/ customer email thread?) 2) ask customer for SAML metadata + test account today 3) send SOC data-retention draft by EOD Friday. I'll add these to the CS playbook for Copperstrand.
Marco (AE): will intro now — forwarding customer thread to @Priya and @Sasha. FYI they flagged a renewal concern: CFO wants usage visibility and ROI reports before Q4 review. Priya, can we prepare a simple dashboard template for finance?
Priya (CS): yes — I'll mock a finance dashboard (MAU, cost per 1k tokens, feature adoption) before kickoff. tagging Dmitri for any metrics we need from infra. @Dmitri can you surface baseline token-costs and perf numbers? :eyes:
Dmitri (Eng): will pull p95/p50 numbers from staging runs and share a small spreadsheet. also I'll add notes on config recommendations (batching, KV cache TTL) for cost control.
Sasha (Support): once we have SAML metadata I'll run through the SP test plan. please put any test accounts in the shared onboarding doc (link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/Copperstrand).
Priya (CS): thanks all — I'll update thread when kickoff is scheduled and attach the CS kickoff agenda. if anyone sees missing owners call it out now. :thumbsup:
